sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Tool registry builder
sections.what: Collects every tool's descriptor and pairs it with its page file, checks that the names and paths agree, sets the page to load on demand, and sorts the tools alphabetically by name.
sections.why: The comments say small descriptors load early and tool code loads only when opened, to keep the app quick.
sections.watch_out: A tool with a mismatched slug or path throws an error while the list is built, and a new tool needs both its metadata and index files.

summary: Finds every tool folder automatically and builds the list of tools the app shows, loading each tool's page only when it is opened.
purpose: Lets new tools appear in the app without anyone editing the route list by hand.
why: The comment says small descriptions load up front and the heavier tool code loads only when its route is opened. This keeps the app fast. The reason for the checks is not stated.
how: It scans the tools folders for metadata and index files. For each tool, it checks that both files exist and that the path matches the slug, then builds a lazily loaded page. It also checks that the page's slug matches the metadata. Finally it sorts the tools by name.
inputs: The metadata and index files in each tool folder.
outputs: The sorted list of tool definitions that the app can show and route to.
risks: A mismatched slug or path stops the list from building, which can break the whole tools area. A new tool must have both files.
debug: If a tool is missing or the tools area fails, search for the registry error about invalid tool registration or metadata mismatch. Then compare the folder name, slug and path.
